_comment: Committed content for the multi_hop family (B-13 P2, JB-4): a stated graph of people/edges (plus optional urgency override) from which the asked person's chain leads to exactly one unit. The builder binds every edge the tree references (true iff stated in the text), so each option's branch is `all(edges on the path from the asked person)` — labels are executions, and unreachable options bind an unstated edge as false.
